text:
mira: Follow-up from design review 1: noticed a few mismatches between console labels and docs. Dropping items here so they're actionable.

mira: 1) Console drawer shows `Model revision`. Docs + API use `model version`. We should pick one.

mira: 2) Sidebar label: `Routes` vs docs `Endpoints`. Customers search for both terms.

mira: 3) In-product help panel opens an iframe without fragment anchors or visible docs version. Need: stable fragment IDs, docs version in header, and an "Open in docs" link.

evan: Agree on `model version` to match API.

liam: Docs tooling can add stable ids to h2/h3 during build. We can also emit a small mapping file `console_slug -> docs_fragment`.

rachel: Copy suggestion for tooltip: `Model version — the exact weights and config used for inference. See docs` with inline code styling for the label. I'll open a docs PR.

docs-bot: Auto-scan: /console/models currently references `model revision` in 2 spots (v1.4). See https://docs.redwood.ai/console/models#diff-issues

mira: Accessibility nits: help panel doesn't always close with Esc and code blocks inside lack a copy button. Add component test for focus return and copy affordance.

sam: Telemetry idea: event `docs_panel.open` with properties `docs_slug`, `docs_fragment`, `docs_version`. Useful to measure deep-link usage.

evan: analytics will add `docs_panel_open` with `help_source` props.

liam: I'll create tickets: docs-tooling (ids + mapping + canonical meta), console (panel header, open-in-docs, highlight-on-open, Esc + copy button), analytics (event + schema).

rachel: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/534 1 replaces `model revision` -> `model version` and adds initial fragments.

mira: Owners: rachel (copy PR), liam (docs-tooling + small console changes), evan (analytics), sam (QA a11y checks).

docs-bot: Reminder: docs sync next Tue 09:30.

mira: Thanks all 1 let's aim to land small changes before next release to reduce onboarding questions. :white_check_mark:
